description: This file contains unit tests for the libhoclient package, focusing on uploading files, handling retries with exponential backoff, and creating CVDs via HTTP API interactions.

methods.name: TestUploadFileChunkSizeBytesIsZeroPanic
methods.description: Tests that uploading a file with zero chunk size results in a panic.

methods.name: TestUploadFileSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies that uploading multiple files with chunking and concurrency succeeds and all chunks are uploaded correctly.

methods.name: TestUploadFileExponentialBackoff
methods.description: Checks that the upload retries implement exponential backoff with increasing delays.

methods.name: TestUploadFileExponentialBackoffReachedElapsedTime
methods.description: Ensures that the exponential backoff retries stop after reaching the maximum elapsed time, and errors are returned appropriately.

methods.name: TestCreateCVD
methods.description: Tests the creation of a CVD (Cloud Virtual Device) via API calls and verifies the response.

methods.name: TestCreateCVDWithUserProjectOverride
methods.description: Verifies that creating a CVD with user project override sends correct headers and processes the response correctly.
